notes: With shuffle on, the Queue tab always shows what's coming: your queued songs, then the shuffled library in the order it will play.
Drag songs in the shuffled list to rearrange it. The shuffle order now stays put (it used to re-roll whenever the song list refreshed); Reshuffle deals a new one.

Drag or flick the chars, claude and clip tabs to the top bar and they become buttons there that drop their panel down; drag them back to the right sidebar any time. Each one remembers where you put it.
Right-click the theme button to go back a theme (left-click still goes forward).
The sound, theme and shortcuts buttons can be dragged or flicked into the right sidebar (and back), styled like the other sidebar tabs.

Drag to select: drag a box over the home page's recent files, the Recent panel, the Files panel or the BoxSpaces tree. Ctrl+click adds one, Shift+click picks a range. Then Del, Enter, or right-click for Open all, Copy paths, Compare (two files) and Delete (Recycle Bin, one question for all).
Drag the home page's Start something and Tools cards into any order you like.
Fixed: two copies of the app (another folder or drive) could open each other's window, settings and music when both were running. Each install now only ever joins its own server.
Fixed: with chars and claude both in the top bar, opening one after the other showed both in the same drop-down, and a docked music player showed through it.

New PB&J theme (after Discord's PB&J gradient): grape jelly fading into warm peanut butter, with the gradient showing through the whole window. Pick it in Settings → Appearance, View, or click the theme button in the top bar to cycle Dark → Light → PB&J.
Copies of the app in different folders or drives no longer get mixed up by Windows: pinning one to the taskbar now always opens that copy. (Re-pin it once after updating.)
The music player remembers the song, the spot in it, the volume and whether it was playing: close the app, restart or update, and it picks up right there.

A queue, separate from the library: right-click a song → Play next / Add to queue, hover it and click +, or drag it onto the Queue tab. Drag queued songs to reorder them. When the queue runs out, the library carries on where it was.
Drag or flick the ♪ button into the right sidebar to dock the player there as its own tab; drag or flick the tab back to the top bar to undock it.
BoxTape: an “Only new songs” button ticks just the songs that aren’t in your audio dump yet.

BoxTape queues downloads: start another playlist while one is downloading and it waits its turn instead of replacing the first. Every download keeps its own progress card, and queued ones can be removed before they start.
Updates from inside the app: Settings → Updates checks GitHub, downloads, checks the new version and installs it on restart. If it doesn't start, the previous version comes back on its own.
Go back to the previous version any time from Settings → Updates (or run “Restore previous version.bat”).
What's new (this window) after every update, and a welcome note the first time the app opens.
Hover a home screen card, the big title, the line under it or the logo and press F2 to change it; Ctrl+F2 puts the original back.
Mouse back / forward buttons move between folders and tabs.
BoxTape takes Spotify playlist, album and song links: each song is matched to the same recording on YouTube and saved as “Artist - Title.mp3”. Songs you already have start unticked.
The music player spots duplicate songs (same file, or “Song (1)”, “Song (Official Video)”…) and can clear the extra copies.
New home screen tagline.
BoxDiff: compare two files side by side — added lines in green, removed in red. Works with text, code, Word, PDF, spreadsheets and pictures.
Menus: hold the mouse on a menu, drag to an item and let go to pick it.
A sharper, more angular logo.
BoxPaint (images with layers) and BoxScribe (offline picture-to-text).
F2 to rename and Del to remove whatever's under the mouse: dump items, layers, songs and files.
